# Security and privacy review — stages

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py from workflow.yaml. -->

Review a system's security and privacy posture: scope and authorisation, threat model update, application and infrastructure review, dependency and secret scanning, privacy analysis, findings with retests, and the security gate decided by an independent auditor with CISO risk acceptance.

**Trigger:** A system approaching release, handling new data categories, or needing a periodic security review.
